timeline.summary: Griselbrand rose to eclipse all other demons, and the Skirsdag gained prominence.
timeline.quote: When the demon Griselbrand rose in power to eclipse all other demons, the Skirsdag gained prominence as well.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn vanished from the Cathedral of Avacyn in Thraben.
timeline.quote: where the archangel herself resided before vanishing

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus, Lunarch, searches desperately for the reason behind the church's declining power.
timeline.quote: Currently, it is held by a man named Mikaeus, who is searching desperately for the reason behind the decline of the church's power.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Gavony and Humans". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With Thraben's army recalled to its walls, outlying villages are left to fend for themselves.
timeline.quote: With Thraben's army recalled to its city walls, outlying villages were left to fend for themselves.

citation.text: Endless Ranks of the Dead (Innistrad, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Reika accuses Jofridus of being a Skirsdag cultist; Jofridus murders her and tries to recruit Amsel, who flees as a heretic.
timeline.quote: Jofridus murdered Reika and tried to recruit Amsel into a demonic pact for eternal life.

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Beneath Thraben Cathedral Amsel destroys a demonic manifestation of Reika and kills Jofridus with the Bloodletter.
timeline.quote: confronted Jofridus and killed him with the cursed blade

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Near death, Amsel dons the unholy yoke Jofridus had worn, giving up his humanity to survive.
timeline.quote: Amsel chose to don the unholy yoke that Jofridus had worn, sacrificing his humanity to survive

citation.text: "Amsel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf sets up the siege of Thraben, sneaks in to kill Mikaeus, and meets Liliana who brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Odric captures Gisa and Liliana causes the sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Shortly thereafter, Liliana caused the sundering of the Helvault .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf starts the siege of Thraben and invites Gisa along, ending their engagement; he sneaks into the city to kill Mikaeus.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana brings Mikaeus back as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Later he met up with Liliana , who shortly thereafter brought Mikaeus back as a zombie .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf kills Mikaeus the Lunarch during the Siege of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Geralf killed Mikaeus the Lunarch

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana kills the Skirsdag leader Volpaig.
timeline.quote: Liliana learned of the dead Lunarch's knowledge from the Skirsdag leader Volpaig as she killed him.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead Lunarch as a zombie.
timeline.quote: she retrieved and resurrected the corpse of the dead Lunarch, turning him into a zombie

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus spends his days reassuring the populace that Avacyn is still among them, which is a lie.
timeline.quote: Mikaeus would spend his days reassuring the populace that all is well

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "Imprisonment of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Lothar dies in the Siege of Thraben, Thalia becomes Guardian of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Thalia became the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Rise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn goes missing, and the church at Thraben conceals the truth while werewolf attacks and hauntings increase.
timeline.quote: Ever since Avacyn went missing last year, the church at Thraben has kept the truth of her disappearance from Innistrad's denizens.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Curfew of Silver decree requires blessed silver amulets for Kessig commoners after dark; relations with Gavony worsen.
timeline.quote: Since the Curfew of Silver, relations between Kessig and Gavony have worsened.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Kessig and Werewolves". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Innistrad to find vampires killing at will, werewolves preying on cathars, and ghouls besieging Thraben, and draws his sword.
timeline.quote: the ancient vampire draws his sword under the light of a grim moon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels imprison the captured demons in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: imprisoning them in a huge mass of silver that came to be called the Helvault

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The demon Griselbrand lands on the Helvault under a full moon and challenges Avacyn to combat.
timeline.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drives Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impales her heart with his spear, and the backlashing binding spell draws her into the Helvault too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand turns the Helvault against Avacyn, trapping her inside and leaving Innistrad without a protector.
timeline.quote: The demon Griselbrand challenged Avacyn and turned the tables at the last moment

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus makes the witnesses swear to secrecy and the Church conceals Avacyn's fate.
timeline.quote: made those few priests who had witnessed the tragedy swear to secrecy

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia orders others to grab axes and defend the gate against despair.
timeline.quote: Grab an axe and defend the gate!

citation.text: Burden of Guilt (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia declares she will not see Thraben fall to the unhallowed horde.
timeline.quote: Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Constable Visil confesses to Thalia his fear of what comes after death, and Thalia reassures him of Avacyn's protection.
timeline.quote: Your soul is protected by the hand of Avacyn and will never submit to evil.

citation.text: Unhallowed Cathar (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A shaman calls Tovolar to gather the howlpack for the Hunter's Moon as Thraben's walls weaken.
timeline.quote: Gather the howlpack, for the Hunter's Moon is nigh and Thraben's walls grow weak.

citation.text: Mondronen Shaman (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Devils infiltrate the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, cracking pillars and burning archives.
timeline.quote: Devils infiltrated the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, making cracks in load-bearing pillars and setting fire to precious archives.

citation.text: Forge Devil (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben; Mikaeus appoints Thalia supreme commander after Luthor is found dead.
timeline.quote: he appointed Thalia as the supreme commander of the city's forces

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf sneaks behind the defenses and stabs Mikaeus with a letter opener, carving out his heart.
timeline.quote: Geralf assaulted him with a letter opener, fatally stabbing the Lunarch

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bishop Alwin decrees Mikaeus be interred secretly to protect faith.
timeline.quote: decreed that Mikaeus would be interred into the tomb of the Lunarchs unceremoniously

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus as a zombie, forces him to reveal the Helvault's secrets, then goes to perform the Sundering.
timeline.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: she forced Thalia to do so by threatening the lives of her soldiers

citation.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Avacyn's absence, Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben; Geralf kills Lunarch Mikaeus and Liliana raises him as a zombie.
timeline.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Lunarch Mikaeus .

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gisa's army breaks the outer wall but is pushed back by fire; Odric captures Gisa.
timeline.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thalia charges into a howlpack of Krallenhorde werewolves to rescue a single old man, impressing Lothar, who makes her one of his elite guardians.
timeline.quote: Lothar made her part of his elite guardians that very day.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn and Griselbrand duel on the Helvault; Griselbrand stabs her, her binding spell backlashes, and both fall into the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Both the devious demon lord and the wounded angel fell into the Helvault , plunging Innistrad into a time of darkness.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus decides to keep the Helvault's nature secret, telling Lothar only to protect it.
timeline.quote: The decision was made, and the nature of the giant silver shard was kept quiet.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia takes the oath to never allow the Helvault to come to harm.
timeline.quote: Thalia took the same oath that Lothar swore

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben with ghouls and skaabs.
timeline.quote: They besieged the city of Thraben with their ghoulish army

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia traps the undead hordes with straw and burns them in a great circle of fire.
timeline.quote: She outwitted the ghouls and skaabs, burning them to ash in a great circle of fire

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Lothar, tormented by evil voices, plunges to his death from a Thraben wall.
timeline.quote: Lothar plunged off one of Thraben's high walls to his death.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus is killed in the assault and entombed in secret beneath the cathedral.
timeline.quote: So Mikaeus was entombed in secret, whisked away to the clandestine catacombs beneath the cathedral.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia becomes the Guardian of Thraben, unknowingly keeping Avacyn sealed.
timeline.quote: Thalia took charge of the elite guardians of Thraben, becoming the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault during the siege of Thraben, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both the demons and Avacyn were released

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Avacyn's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus Cecani's corpse and learns Griselbrand is trapped in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: learning from him that Griselbrand was trapped in the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Odric reflects in Thraben that Avacyn's return has ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
timeline.quote: The phases of the moon were no longer predictors of life and death now that Avacyn had returned and cleansed the world.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
timeline.quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete reports that the mayor's son in Torbach died after fleeing a werewolf; Odric, doubting in his heart, orders the regiment roused.
timeline.quote: "Rouse our regiment," he told Grete.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, empowered by Traft's geist, Thalia fights Eldrazi; Sigarda rescues her from Brisela and they defeat the fused sisters.
timeline.quote: Together, Thalia and Sigardia bested the fused sisters.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana broods in her manor during a storm, recalling how she made demonic pacts and used the Chain Veil to kill demons and take Thraben.
timeline.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
timeline.quote: I have to go to Thraben,

citation.text: "Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
timeline.quote: I am in need of a mentor

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
timeline.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia rides to Thraben Cathedral, furious after witnessing atrocities at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: The ride from the Elgaud Grounds in Nephalia to Thraben Cathedral had taken days

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confronts Odric, demanding he stop the inquisition's burning of children at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: We're burning children now.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia declares she can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.
timeline.quote: I can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric urges Thalia to leave Thraben and has Grete escort her beyond the wall.
timeline.quote: Will you please escort Thalia beyond the outer wall?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia tells Grete she will fight, even against the angels if she must.
timeline.quote: I'm going to fight,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Weeks later Thalia bursts into the Lunarch Council, where Odric tells her the council has removed her title; she realizes he informed the council of her heresy.
timeline.quote: The council has removed it from you.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia accuses Bishop Jerren of communion with Ormendahl and of leading the Skirsdag.
timeline.quote: I bring evidence that you have been in communion with the demon Ormendahl, called the Profane Prince, and you are now the leader of the Skirsdag.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia presents a bloodstained letter bearing Jerren's seal giving instructions to the witch in the Profane Prince's name.
timeline.quote: The letter bears the seal and signature of none other than Bishop Jerren, giving instructions to this witch in the name of the Profane Prince!

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Several bishops refuse the letter until Carlin takes it and pales as she reads.
timeline.quote: Three bishops refused her as the council sat in stony silence, before Bishop Carlin took it with a quivering hand.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: The council calls for Thalia's execution and cathars seize her on Jerren's signal.
timeline.quote: Cathars came and seized Thalia's arms before she could draw it, looking to Jerren for direction.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric, shaken by the council's cruelty, goes to Thalia's cell and tells the guard to open it, planning to leave with her.
timeline.quote: We are leaving here, together.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
timeline.quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric disarms and wounds Dougan, and Grete kills Marta in the fight against the eight cathars.
timeline.quote: Marta, fighting on despite the wound in her shoulder, fell under Grete's heavy sword.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric kills Haral, leaving all eight cathars bleeding or dying on the cathedral floor.
timeline.quote: The inevitable opening came, and Odric took it without thinking, slashing the man's throat open.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: The three escape the cathedral and leave Thraben on horseback.
timeline.quote: And they left the cathedral, then left Thraben, left their old lives far behind.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo drifts through Thraben Cathedral's chantry, investigating why Innistrad is off its axis.
timeline.quote: Despite the fact that her feet never touched the stone floor, Tamiyo thought about tiptoeing as she slowly drifted through the chantry of Thraben Cathedral.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo has come to the cathedral to study the oldest histories of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Her latest line of research had brought her to the cathedral, where the humans of Innistrad housed their oldest histories of Avacyn.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo invokes the story He Who Frightens the Sun to blend in unseen among the cathars.
timeline.quote: The story invoked, its magic became real, and Tamiyo faded from view.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo finds a young planeswalker holding her field notes standing over a collapsed librarian.
timeline.quote: And standing over him...a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
timeline.quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace's eyes grow calm and he recovers his senses.
timeline.quote: The young human's eyes closed, and he took several deep, slow breaths.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: he didn't survive it.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Jace to leave, warning that a mad telepath is a danger across planes.
timeline.quote: You need to leave, Jace.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
timeline.quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
timeline.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo agrees to anchor Jace's mind if they link minds, and Jace accepts.
timeline.quote: But...in theory, I could anchor you.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Jace link minds, each learning the other's past and burdens.
timeline.quote: In an instant, he knew her.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
timeline.quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
timeline.quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn brands Tamiyo an intruder and impure and attacks.
timeline.quote: Intruder. Invader. Rotmonger. Impure! IMPURE!

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo fights Avacyn with the story Winter's Howl, freezing parts of her wings.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo let loose precisely targeted blasts of icy gale

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
timeline.quote: And then she froze.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
timeline.quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
timeline.quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
timeline.quote: Sometimes, our stories have to end.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn blasts Tamiyo back against the wall with her light.
timeline.quote: I push toward her with my hand, and my light blasts the demon back.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
timeline.quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
timeline.quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
timeline.quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
timeline.quote: I am your creator

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
timeline.quote: He is the reason I exist.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees images of burning villages and slain innocents and realizes she herself set the fires.
timeline.quote: I have set those fires. I have slain those innocents.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
timeline.quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
timeline.quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn's angels one by one, draining one.
timeline.quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
timeline.quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
timeline.quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
timeline.quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
timeline.quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
timeline.quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
timeline.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
timeline.quote: The plane has lost its protector

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: A tremor shakes the cathedral, shattering stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face.
timeline.quote: The world rumbled again, this time under Jace's feet.

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
timeline.quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
timeline.quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia declines to force possession on those who cannot accept the spirits.
timeline.quote: I can't make that choice for them.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's army passes through Thraben's Outer Wall and fights alongside vampires through the streets.
timeline.quote: They were fighting shoulder to shoulder with vampires now, making their way through the streets of the city.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia stabs Seeta, chief of the Sinpurged, from behind.
timeline.quote: Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A huge fused angel of flesh, tentacles and feathered wings looms before Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: Drifting in the air in front of the cathedral was a huge abomination formed of twisted flesh, writhing tentacles...and feathered wings.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia attacks the angel-thing on her gryff and is slashed down, her gryff killed.
timeline.quote: In response, the angel brought its other arm up and slashed a half-dozen finger-claws down her side and across her gryff's flank

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives and disowns her fused sisters.
timeline.quote: You are no longer my sisters,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda slashes her sisters with her scythe but is snatched and being absorbed into the angel-thing.
timeline.quote: But one of those huge, strangely bifurcated arms snatched Sigarda out of the air.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
timeline.quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia drives Avacyn's spear through the angel-thing's back and into its spine.
timeline.quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda bursts from the dying angel-thing's chest, and the creature falls dead, calling her sister.
timeline.quote: And it followed Sigarda to the hard stone of the plaza below, curling like a dead spider on the ground.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A vast tentacled thing approaches Thraben as a tidal wave of corrupted monsters smashes into the plaza.
timeline.quote: As it approached, a tidal wave of corrupted monstrosities crested before it, smashing into the plaza and turning the tide once more toward annihilation.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana watches the Gatewatch head into Thraben from above, with Gared and her raised army.
timeline.quote: Those must be Jace's little friends.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
timeline.quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
timeline.quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
timeline.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa pulls up three spectral vines to tap the leylines; the third, darker vine strangles her.
timeline.quote: it had managed to wrap itself around her neck

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa cries out and collapses; the glyph goes dark and the plan fails as the horde keeps coming.
timeline.quote: The glyph went instantly dark.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
timeline.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombie army pours into the square and forms a defensive perimeter around the planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: they parted, formed a defensive perimeter around them, and started pushing outward.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears with the Chain Veil and wipes out the mutated creatures with necromantic energy, rescuing the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Liliana floated forth, arms spread wide, the Chain Veil hovering just beyond her fingertips.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace refuses Liliana's demand to planeswalk away, insisting they can finish the job with her help.
timeline.quote: We need to finish this. We're so close.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
timeline.quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Hordes of Eldrazi and cultists overran Thraben's defenses and the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Hordes of Eldrazi and cultists swarmed over Thraben's defenses

citation.text: Emrakul's Influence (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ghouls surged through Thraben's streets.
timeline.quote: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets

citation.text: Dark Salvation (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of Saint Traft cleared the roads so villagers could flee Thraben.
timeline.quote: The Order of Saint Traft cleared the roads of cultists and horrors

citation.text: Ride Down (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sigarda's banner and Thalia's leadership rallied the uncorrupted.
timeline.quote: The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.

citation.text: Thraben Standard Bearer (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Cathedral Avacyn overpowers Jace and Tamiyo, then Sorin arrives and tells her he is her creator.
timeline.quote: Sorin told her that he was her creator, and Avacyn's madness momentarily withdrew

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben the Gatewatch is saved by Liliana; Chandra then defends the others during the sealing of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: When it became clear that they could not destroy Emrakul, Chandra joined Gideon in defending the other members of the Gatewatch while they conducted the sealing ritual.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin saves Jace and Tamiyo from Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral and, after a battle, unmakes his corrupted creation.
timeline.quote: Sorin was forced to unmake his corrupted guardian in the same spot where she was born

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Sigarda slays Brisela, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the Moon of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon of Innistrad

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, corrupted by Emrakul's presence, attacks humanity and is destroyed by her creator Sorin Markov in the Cathedral of Thraben.
timeline.quote: a final confrontation in the Cathedral of Thraben with her creator, Sorin Markov , who ultimately destroyed her

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Unmaking of Avacyyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
timeline.quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man and the Chain Veil both urge Liliana to flee, frightened of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Whatever Emrakul was, the Chain Veil wanted no part of it.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
timeline.quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana refuses to be a vessel, silences the Veil and the Raven Man, and prepares to fight Emrakul.
timeline.quote: She shut down the voices of the Veil and the Raven Man both, silencing them abruptly.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
timeline.quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
timeline.quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man tells Liliana her death is now the best possible outcome and she becomes afraid.
timeline.quote: You have doomed us both.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
timeline.quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The two Jaces merge; learning Liliana is about to die, Jace dissolves the spell and returns to reality.
timeline.quote: Jace dissolved the spell.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
timeline.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
timeline.quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon and linking it to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I have a binding spell. A powerful one. I can attune it to the moon.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa agrees to power the spell because Jace freed her mind from Emrakul's darkness.
timeline.quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren. I will try.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo begins reading her scroll and Jace fastens a glyph on the moon to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: A glyph flashed onto the moon

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa collapses having drained the leylines, and the spell is about to fail.
timeline.quote: It was not going to be enough.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo, cut off from Jace's mind, reads a second iron-banded scroll, and a flood of mana pours into the spell.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo pulled out another scroll, a long scroll, a scroll with iron bands

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
timeline.quote: May you rot there forever.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: My very own Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
timeline.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
timeline.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
timeline.quote: It...she...took me over.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
timeline.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo asks if they really won and flies off into the dark sky with no parting words.
timeline.quote: Eventually she rose and flew into the dark sky.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
timeline.quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia vows not to see Thraben fall to the unhallowed horde.
timeline.quote: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Masters 25, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya's research turns up a book showing the Betzolds being handed a box by a witch, and Arlinn recognizes Worrin Betzold's name as an old bishop.
timeline.quote: The caption labeled them the Betzolds, from Gavony.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline spots Worrin preaching to a congregation of zombies in the nave, and Arlinn confirms it is him.
timeline.quote: To Arlinn's horror, he seems to be preaching to a gathered crowd.

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn questions the undead Worrin about the key, but he only answers with Dennick's name, and she puts him to rest.
timeline.quote: Arlinn gives Worrin the only rest she can

citation.work: Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Fall of the House of Betzold" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Cathars patrol the ruins of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Terms like "safe route" and "cleared district" are a source of dark humor to the cathars who patrol the ruins of Thraben.

citation.text: Odric's Outrider (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ghouls surge through Thraben's streets, bringing the city's salvation.
timeline.quote: Countless ghouls surged through Thraben's streets, and with them came the city's salvation.

citation.text: Dark Salvation (Midnight Hunt Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
timeline.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: Do not contact me again.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
timeline.quote: The plate shattered against the wall

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt, a risen ghoul with his own army, marches toward Thraben to win Gisa's love.
timeline.quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
timeline.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
timeline.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa spots an army of the dead led by a rider approaching Thraben and runs to meet it, delighted to have something to do.
timeline.quote: Someone was riding along the road to Thraben.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt reaches the gates and declares himself to Gisa, who does not remember him and tries to whistle him into thralldom.
timeline.quote: Finally, tilting her head to the side, she asked, "Do I know you?"

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa's whistle tries to bind Wilhelt, but he resists and breaks her hold; Gisa retreats behind the gates.
timeline.quote: breaking the tie between them as Gisa's whistle died, choked off in her throat

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt breaks through the gates and his army is attacked by swarms of undead birds, then by the dead who surge out of the shops.
timeline.quote: They were halfway down the avenue when the dead surged out of the buildings to either side

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa urges Wilhelt to surrender; he refuses, so she leaves her soldiers to overwhelm his.
timeline.quote: Then she flounced away down the walk, not looking back

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt sends a ghoul with a love letter to Gisa, but she seizes the ghoul's mind and reads it.
timeline.quote: A single ghoul ran into the square

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa reads Wilhelt's letter, is offended that he implies she could get his name wrong, and resolves to destroy him.
timeline.quote: She resolved to destroy him.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa screams and all the bats in Thraben descend on Wilhelt's army, forcing him to flee.
timeline.quote: Then Gisa screamed, and all the bats in Thraben descended.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt vanishes from the battlefield, and Gisa decides to go to her brother.
timeline.quote: Wilham himself was gone.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
timeline.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

citation.text: "The Dance of Undeath" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The group finds Thraben destroyed and full of zombies, and Kaya scouts alone and finds a clue about the Key.
timeline.quote: They find the city destroyed and full of zombies

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adeline rides at the vanguard killing zombies as the group reaches Bishop Worrin Betzold.
timeline.quote: Adeline on her horse went to the vanguard of the group, killing several zombies

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn kills the zombified Worrin Betzold out of mercy after learning the name Dennick.
timeline.quote: In an act of mercy she kills her friend so he can rest in peace.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two years after Emrakul's sealing, Gisa takes control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and makes Thraben her own.
timeline.quote: Gisa took control of Liliana's abandoned zombie army and made Thraben her own

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gisa easily defeats the army of her suitor Wilhelt, forcing him to leave.
timeline.quote: Gisa easily defeated Wilhelt's army, forcing him to leave.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key; they begin in Thraben.
timeline.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Thraben a coalition of vampires, the Order of Saint Traft, the Gatewatch and zombies defeat Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists after Sigarda kills Brisela; Emrakul is imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was imprisoned within Innistrad's Moon

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the battle Thraben lies in ruins; Gisa takes control of Liliana's zombies and rejects Wilhelt, who besieges the city and is defeated.
timeline.quote: Wilhelt then left Thraben, defeated.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thalia, Odric and the cathars refuse to abandon the ruined city and keep waging war on the zombies.
timeline.quote: still wage war on the zombies that prowl the streets

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thalia vows not to rest until Thraben is cleansed.
timeline.quote: I will not rest until it is cleansed.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.
timeline.quote: These days, ghouls are the only abundant resource in Thraben.

citation.text: Catapult Fodder (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Caught scavenging in besieged Thraben, Torens is spared by Odric and made Mausoleum Guard by Thalia.
timeline.quote: Thalia put Torens to work as Mausoleum Guard .

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Odric's ouster, Torens deserts the cathars with a holy mace.
timeline.quote: He took a holy mace with him as a souvenir.

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thalia marshals cathars, townspeople, and ghoulcallers into a fighting force to defend Thraben.
timeline.quote: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog Monster saves Thalia from Phyrexians and lets her ride it into battle.
timeline.quote: the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reika Eberhardt dies under mysterious circumstances in Thraben, pushing Adila into deeper conflict with the church.
timeline.quote: under mysterious circumstances in Thraben

citation.text: "Adila Rimheit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vampires, angels, humans and planeswalkers unite at Thraben against Emrakul and Nahiri's cultists.
timeline.quote: Together, they formed a coalition to resist the Eldrazi and the cultists loyal to Nahiri.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses her undead army to hold critical positions.
timeline.quote: Liliana’s strategic use of her undead army to hold critical positions

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sigarda slays Brisela, the turning point of the battle.
timeline.quote: Sigarda , the archangel untouched by madness, confronted and slew Brisela

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The victory ends the Eldrazi invasion and Nahiri's campaign of vengeance.
timeline.quote: The victory at Thraben marked the end of the Eldrazi invasion and Nahiri’s campaign of vengeance.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Boulder rejoins Arlinn in Thraben Cathedral and helps her to her feet as she faces Tovolar.
timeline.quote: helping them to her feet and staying close

citation.text: "Boulder", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya finds an old book showing the Key was given to an ancestor of the Betzold family.
timeline.quote: Kaya finds an old book showing that the Key was given to an ancestor of the Betzold family by a warlock

citation.text: "Dennick Betzold", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and Adeline find Bishop Worrin Betzold among the zombie army, now a zombie, and get the name Dennick from him.
timeline.quote: Arlinn and her companions manage to get the name Dennick from the bishop

citation.text: "Dennick Betzold", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gared accompanies Liliana to Thraben but waits outside during the battle.
timeline.quote: Gared did not participate in the Battle of Thraben directly, waiting outside

citation.text: "Gared", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog Monster rescues Thalia from Phyrexians at Thraben and lets her ride it.
timeline.quote: the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her

citation.text: "Gitrog monster", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
timeline.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Odric and Grete capture the cursed Garruk, and Odric drugs him and takes him to Thraben.
timeline.quote: Odric then drugged the planeswalker, tied him up, and moved him to Thraben

citation.text: "Odric", section "Meeting Garruk Wildspeaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Arlinn was gravely injured in Thraben Cathedral, the pack returned to her side.
timeline.quote: when Arlinn was gravely injured in Thraben Cathedral , the pack returned to her side

citation.text: "Redtooth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reika discovers Father Jofridus performing a Skirsdag ritual under Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: She discovered Father Jofridus participating in a Skirsdag ritual beneath the cathedral.

citation.text: "Reika Eberhardt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reika steals the Bloodletter from the Cathedral vault but is captured by the Order and forced to fight in the pits.
timeline.quote: she stole the Bloodletter from the secret vault of Thraben Cathedral

citation.text: "Reika Eberhardt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jofridus kills Reika with the Bloodletter after she outs him to Amsel.
timeline.quote: before the cultist killed her with the Bloodletter

citation.text: "Reika Eberhardt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa unleash hordes of ghouls, skaabs and Grimgrin on Thraben's walls.
timeline.quote: The Siege of Thraben saw Geralf and Gisa unleash vast hordes of ghouls , skaabs , and the monstrous Grimgrin

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf infiltrates the city to murder Mikaeus while Gisa's dead batter the gates until the main wall falls.
timeline.quote: until the main wall finally fell

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thalia burns the outer ring using stolen thatch, incinerating the undead and halting the siege.
timeline.quote: Thalia set the outer ring ablaze using stolen thatch from Thraben’s rooftops

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana tracks down Volpaig for information on Griselbrand and slays him after he accidentally reveals only Mikaeus knew where Griselbrand was.
timeline.quote: He was slain by Liliana

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lothar dies in a madness-fueled fall from the ramparts.
timeline.quote: Lothar , the venerable Guardian of Thraben, perished in a madness-fueled fall from the high ramparts.

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf stabs Mikaeus to death; he is secretly entombed beneath the Cathedral.
timeline.quote: After being personally stabbed to death by Geralf, Mikaeus was secretly entombed beneath the Cathedral

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana exhumes Mikaeus's corpse and learns Griselbrand is imprisoned within the Helvault.
timeline.quote: forcing it to reveal that Griselbrand was imprisoned within the Helvault

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral battling Jace and Tamiyo and is forced to destroy her.
timeline.quote: Sorin was forced to destroy his beloved creation

citation.text: "The Travails", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sigarda rallies the sane angels, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the silver moon at the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was finally imprisoned within Innistrad’s silver moon

citation.text: "The Travails", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Tamiyo fail to restrain Avacyn at Thraben Cathedral; Sorin arrives and confronts her.
timeline.quote: planeswalkers Jace Beleren and Tamiyo attempted to restrain Avacyn but failed.

citation.text: "Unmaking of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Thraben, Arlinn's group finds Worrin as an undead preacher addressing zombies in the ruined cathedral and fights through the hordes.
timeline.quote: disturbingly preaching to a congregation of zombies within the ruined cathedral

citation.text: "Worrin Betzold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn questions undead Worrin about the Key, but he only repeats "Dennick"; out of mercy she puts him to rest.
timeline.quote: out of a sense of mercy, Arlinn put him to rest

citation.text: "Worrin Betzold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
